name: smwmusic-super-mario-world-pirate-underground
title: Super Mario World (Pirate) - Underground
description:
The Sampled Version of the Underground theme from Bootleg SMW.

Can be used, well, underground levels.

Midi by PalaceSwitcher.

Uses lots of noise, it's not recommended for levels with noise sound effects. (Which means no Podoboos, sorry!)

Doesn't use vanilla noise anymore.

Edit: Now uses actual noise samples from the original.
(Although be aware that the samples are of high quality)
